request.raw_text: Insert screws to both holes to be able to fix tool on the table

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The two circular through-holes near the opposite ends of the elongated base plate
areas_to_change.location: One screw in each end mounting hole, with each screw axis coaxial with its hole and oriented through the base plate from the exposed top face toward the table-facing underside
areas_to_change.description: Add one screw to each of the two base mounting holes. Position the screw heads on the accessible upper face of the base and extend the shanks through the holes for engagement with a table or associated fastening hardware.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The model or assembly will contain two screws, each aligned concentrically with one of the two end holes in the base plate. Their heads will be visible on the upper base surface and their shanks will pass through the plate.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The screws provide two fastening points for securing the tool base to a table.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: When tightened into threaded table holes or mating nuts, the screws clamp the base against the table and resist translation, lifting, and rotation during use.
